description: Produces WAV, Ogg or Opus files: the audio file a user asks for, to download or to embed in a game, app, presentation or video. A request for a song, a tune or music needs no file: song's share link plays it in the browser (the share link plays it, no render), and each render counts against the hourly render quota. Send mtl, ref (a songId) or compose; it checks the song itself (complete syntax: describe topic=syntax). One file holds about 8 min as WAV (about 5 at 24-bit 48 kHz), longer as Ogg or Opus; a longer request is refused with the exact limit. len gives exact seconds; loop:true adds seamless loop points; stems:true gives one file per instrument role (@lead, @bass, @drums...); adaptive:true gives a zip of same-length looping layers in intensities, stingers from extra cues, a manifest, a Web Audio player and Godot, Unity, FMOD and Wwise notes; cues renders named sections. A long render replies rendering with asset ids, and assets(ids) gives the links when done. Files last 2 h; https://moosetracker.app/acceptable-use.html Schema 2d544474.

levels.description: Your own intensities in order, each a list of roles: {"explore":["pad"],"fight":["pad","bass","drums","lead"]}

adaptive.description: A zip of same-length looping layers grouped into intensities (default calm, tense, full; set your own with adaptive.levels), stingers from extra cues, manifest.json, a Web Audio player and setup notes for Godot, Unity, FMOD and Wwise (describe topic=loops)

audition.description: Hear one channel alone as a preview; try swaps its sound: {ch:3, try:"i3 \"Warm Pad\""}

compose.description: Instead of mtl: {bpm, form, chords, parts:[{id,gen}]}. describe(topic="generators")

detail.description: Adds score, per-section loudness and MIX flags with fixes

format.description: Default wav; ogg = Vorbis 44.1 kHz; opus = Ogg Opus 48 kHz

len.description: Exact seconds: a short song repeats its order (said in the result), a long one fades out; never silence

mtl.description: Song in MTL text (describe topic=mtl). Kept 2 hours as a working copy: later calls can send ref (the songId) instead.

preview.description: One section (range, default 1), ≤20 s Opus, light quota, MIX flags

ref.description: Instead of mtl: a songId from an earlier reply (kept 2 hours), a render asset id, or a share link

skip_review.description: Reason to skip a full song's deep review (else it comes first)

name: render
title: Render a song to audio
